summary: Count exhausted native SLO objectives in Mac signal tiles

schema.detail: Consumes existing SLO rows without changing wire schemas or generated clients.

compatibility.detail: Mac aggregate signal counts include exhausted objectives. When server tone is absent, exhausted is red and burning is yellow, matching server classification. Ratio and gauge readings and paired-burn explanations retain their server text.

recovery.detail: Ordinary app rollback; no persisted state changes.
